run_TAPIR_forward: run the TAPIR model forward pass to predict point tracks, occlusion, and uncertainty from a video and query points
create_TAPIR_model: create a TAPIR model instance with configurable resolution, mixer blocks, and softmax temperature
build_feature_grids: build feature grids from a video tensor using ResNet encoding at multiple resolutions for trajectory computation
estimate_trajectories: estimate point trajectories across video frames given feature grids and query features with cost volume matching and PIPs refinement
refine_pips: refine point tracks using PIPS MLP mixer with multi-scale pyramid features and causal convolution
